text: Everpeak went from 40,000 accounts renewing with no real warning to a validated, explainable, weekly churn risk score genuinely in use today.
This isn't a highlight reel. One real leakage bug was found and fixed along the way, and that's a better outcome than never finding it.
Three real gaps, named plainly: no automated retrain trigger, no automated drift or performance monitoring, no automated retention action.
Outreach to a flagged account is still, by design, a human email or call -- and a prioritized list exists for what comes next.
Series complete. Twenty videos, one real incident found and fixed, and an honest account of what's still ahead.
